H: On two finite artifact families, flat/literal and structure-preserving routes can pass the same representation-neutral initial effect contract, while the declared follow-up mix reverses their initial-cost ranking; an independently reconstructed assay detects both the inversion and cases where flat output is preferable.

D.stop: Source/image/output/provenance mismatch, unavailable WSLc boundary, or candidate/audit execution failure before a complete interpretable raw record.

C: The fixture and operation costs are hand-authored abstractions. Operation units do not measure human, model, GUI, tool, or wall-clock effort. The follow-up distribution is illustrative, not estimated from users. Spreadsheet/drawing states are finite and deterministic.
U: This only establishes whether the T0 assay detects a planted ranking inversion and negative controls. It does not establish realistic artifact editability, actual application semantics, route performance, user agency/preference, future-change prevalence, model behavior, or product benefit.
